description: H10 re-audits R01-R08 completed Rust ownership. It promotes the already-fixed TerminalCore InvalidKeyEvent contract to Exact, records Microsoft's explicitly ignored multi-code-point FZF full-fold case as Partial rather than Missing, and supersedes per-suite/global coverage expectations without rewriting historical classification evidence.

entries.notes: Commit 0e80c6b fixed the Microsoft VK 0/255, scan-code 123 vectors so both are silently unhandled. The direct Rust regression now reproduces the complete Microsoft observable.

Microsoft marks this source method Ignore=true because the current C++ matcher does not implement full case folding where ß expands to ss. Rust materially owns German ß matching and ordinary case-insensitive folding, but likewise does not implement the multi-code-point expansion; the unsupported expansion remains explicit debt rather than an unclassified Missing row.
